reviews.title: Didn't think they could make this app any worse
reviews.text:
Not quite sure how the guy who created this app is a billionaire cause it is a P. O. S.
Forced to use this app by the company I work for and can't wait till the day I can delete it. 
When I block a day off, it's still schedules me with appointments.  All of my coworkers also complain about it, but I work for a DEI company and they're just as dumb as the guy who created this app.

reviews.title: Used to be great!
reviews.text: Automatic App upgrades have made it not sync or as easily navigated as before. Frustrated. Watched help videos. Tried to update account settings in app… impossible!

reviews.title: Super slow app
reviews.text: This app is super slow. You don’t have title for appointment only name and last name

reviews.title: The app sucks
reviews.text: I’ve updated my hours on her multiple times and the app has an issue where it simply will not save the changes.  So annoying!

reviews.title: It’s okay
reviews.text: I book lessons once a month and have to stop in the middle of scheduling because of “recaptcha.” The lessons don’t always update when you reschedule either, sending old appointment times to clients. Not the most professional app.

reviews.title: Thoroughly garbage, unintuitive interface
reviews.text: It'll tell you it’s synced with your Google Calendar, but it won’t be. Events that are in your Google Calendar plain as day, will fail to appear in Calendly and vice versa. Trying to add things into Calendly is like pulling teeth. Touch the date, nothing happens.

reviews.title: Connect
reviews.text: Won’t let me see all my meeting booked through the account on computer- despite it being the same account

reviews.title: Worse with every update
reviews.text: Successive updates make it harder to block off time you’re unavailable. You have to go into your account in a web browser on your computer. Why isn’t this a super obvious feature on the home page of the app?

reviews.title: Too sensitive
reviews.text: The app is beautifully displayed and very organized though the app is too sensitive itself and I had to try multiple times in order to have my hours available without merging with other ones when I should have the option to override that, but there is none.

reviews.title: Going down hill
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the ap for about 5 years. Every update they do has made the ap more flakey, increased calendar sync issues, make the layout harder to use. 
With the latest ap update… 
Now the ap sends a notice that you have a new event scheduled but when you get to the ap’s calendar isn’t not there all. Sometimes it takes hours to show up. 
The Google Calendar sync as of two updates ago sometimes takes days for it to sync and show up. It used to be almost instant. They say a google issue but it didn’t have that issue at all until Calendly did their update. It can’t be a coincidence. 
Icons sometimes are overlayed with your events and are randomly in the obviously wrong spots. It’s a mess. 
What was a straight forward easy to use ap now has slowly tried to become more fluffy that ultimately uses too many resources and lost functionality.   Please slim back down the ap to more utility less bubble gum graphics and get out your bug spray out. Cause it’s infested with bugs and likely redundant programming eating up bandwidth. Later gators.  I’m going shopping.

reviews.title: new app is buggy
reviews.text: The updated version of what was once a great app is not great. Bring back the reliable Calendly, please!

reviews.title: No help
reviews.text: No recurring appointment option, flags you when you try to book a recurring

reviews.title: Poor
reviews.text: Every time I try and edit my availability today it keeps asking me to log in when I’m in already. It often notes appointments to clients as 2 different times the actual time slot and one hour later. Doesn’t adjust well to different time zones.

reviews.title: Update is not great
reviews.text: They just vibe coded the most recent update and the UI sucks. It’s looks bad and doesn’t flow well.

reviews.title: iPad
reviews.text: There are bugs. That don’t allow keyboard to appear at login for iPad mini

reviews.title: Terrible Mobile App
reviews.text:
I cannot explain how frustrating it is to use the app for this on your phone. I run an insurance agency and schedule appointments on this app on a consistent basis.

The amount of times I would book an appointment and would have to refresh and close out the app to have it reflect the correct new schedule was absolutely ridiculous. 

Even canceled appointment still show on the calendar. I don’t know what the hell they did to this app, but it has gone downhill tremendously. I’ll probably just gonna stick to booking my appointments on Zoom and stay away from this app.

reviews.title: Inconsistent
reviews.text: Using the Calendly app and using the web client is like using two different platforms, minimal consistency to use both.

reviews.title: Glitching
reviews.text: Whenever I make an adjustment to a meeting type, it reverts back to the schedule of Monday through Friday nine to five.

reviews.title: They changed the whole interface and I can’t find my events now
reviews.text: Wtf

reviews.title: Want to love but cant
reviews.text: I keep missing meetings bc calendly wont schedule to ical. It suddenly stopped sending meeting reminders to me so ive missed a couple very important client meetings.

reviews.title: No iCloud integration
reviews.text: Make zero sense why they would remove this feature. I’m already looking for alternatives.

reviews.title: Extremely complicated to setup
reviews.text: Extremely complicated to setup

reviews.title: Issues
reviews.text: Struggling to reestablish the calendar functionality due to the lack of user-friendly options. Instead of providing useful assistance, it keeps presenting irrelevant articles. No real support whatsoever.

reviews.title: No longer supporting iOS
reviews.text: That’s a big miss. Have Apple devices & it’s no longer supporting iOS Calendar. I discovered there are many other better and cheaper (even free) options out there. Now I just have to figure out how to cancel this service.

reviews.title: Not able to log in
reviews.text: The app is not letting me login right now. This needs to be fixed ASAP.

reviews.title: No support for free plan
reviews.text: I have used Calendly for a few years without a problem. It was perfect for what I needed. Recently there has been problem after problem that I can’t fix. My calender keeps changing to say that I am available indefinitely into the future, rather than the 90 days rolling option  I need. This week all of my date overrides disappeared so that people can book on days I am unavailable. Today I found that my custom schedule has disappeared and will only show a standard weekday schedule with the hours the same for every day. I have tried to update it but it disappears each time. Because I am on the free plan all I can do is talk to the AI chat bot which can only offer to connect me to an agent via an email ticket. When I click to check the status of those tickets they don’t exist. There is no help and no support.

reviews.title: Not really that intuitive for folks that aren’t that techie.
reviews.text:
I’m the resident tech guy in our company, sometimes I wish I wasn’t, but you give the Calendly dashboard over to someone who isn’t that techy and you direct them to the meeting section, and why isn’t there just a button that says start this meeting, it seems like I have to click on and click off to get this button to show up. And I know the meeting isn’t starting 

Why is it so secretive on how to get these buttons. Make them visible, make it for a user to go from one meeting to the next with ease. Jeez!

reviews.title: Why does Calendly keep disconnecting my zoom??
reviews.text: Really annoying when clients book meetings and zoom links are not attached!!

reviews.title: cant see am/pm
reviews.text: travel frequently and use a vpn: cant be sure if the time I booked the meeting is correct as there's no am/pm option or 24h setting. it's maddening

reviews.title: Great product when it works. When it doesn’t work don’t expect any help from Customer Support
reviews.text: Customer Support will send you a bunch of unintelligible info on how you can fix the problems yourself - good luck with that!

reviews.title: Not a great support system
reviews.text: I tried to use Calendly for my business but turned put it couldn’t synchronise my calendars (gmail/iOS), there were no note about upcoming renewing subscription that i am not even using (none checked if it’s effectively working for it customers or what could be improved) It os hard to get help from agent if i have individual problems, cause of constant log in issues, i wanted refund as it wasn’t working for me adequately

reviews.text: Calendly has zero phone support even for their business accounts. I’ll pay too much per month to not have support.

reviews.title: Error messages and glitches
reviews.text: Unhappy this is frustrating I will not upgrade not worth it!

reviews.title: What happened to the free version?
reviews.text: This was such a great tool and now it’s only for those who are rich enough to afford it. I loved being able to schedule appointments with my clients for free.  Now I can’t do that anymore.  $10 a month may not sound like much, but all those “little” fees really add up!!

reviews.title: Too complicated 👎👎👎👎
reviews.text: I thought this app would SAVE me time. But every update makes it more complex. Then you don’t get any help they send you to a link to read a whole thesis or to study videos on YouTube. I personally don’t have time to learn yet another app. Which is why I downloaded Calendly because it was supposed to be EASY. But it’s not. Right now I overwrote a specific date and my clients are not able to book with me causing me loses. 👎

reviews.title: Can’t do what i thought it could
reviews.text: I researched extensively to find an app I needed for a specific situation. Found calendly signed up for a year £90 (yes very stupid) then found I had to invest the same again to get the function. Meanwhile had a much cheaper option with s lifetime subscription which could do this automatically. It’s a much better app day to day.

reviews.title: From good to terrible mobile experience
reviews.text: It was all working seamlessly until mobile app ceased to work. Required me log in and then it goes to a browser and the nightmare began where. “Oops something went wrong” is all I see now instead of my flipping calendar. I write to support and the robot chat just makes you waste time with general useless suggestions. Then as I found out what email to write to, they took two days to respond a seemingly template answer saying it was all resolved. Not the case. I have been spending time researching to see whether it is a setting pf my phone and responding to emails from support agents who just keep asking me to explain and to send more screenshots. Truly disconcerted here. I will research what other platforms are available for me to switch. Not worthy to pay for a service that is not that friendly to navigate and set up. The web version seems slow and now this.

reviews.title: Can’t set time zone outside US
reviews.text: Awful app. Can’t alter the appointment mid creation and can’t select a time zone other than USA/Canada or Americas. The list of time zones is not scrollable when creating an appointment poll. Seems poorly designed for a professional paid for app.
